document.lead: You should spend about 40 minutes on this task.

text: On many winter days, residents of cities such as Almaty wake up to a grey haze that hides the mountains and makes breathing difficult. Such pollution is more than an inconvenience, since long-term exposure to it is linked to heart and lung disease. In my view, this pollution has several connected causes, and it can only be reduced through a combination of cleaner energy and better transport.

The most visible cause is road traffic. The number of private cars has risen rapidly in most growing cities, and many of them are old vehicles with inefficient engines. At the same time, power stations and private houses that burn coal release large amounts of smoke, especially during the heating season. Geography can make the situation worse: in cities surrounded by mountains, polluted air is trapped close to the ground for days when there is little wind.

Tackling the problem therefore requires action on several fronts. First, governments should help power plants and households switch from coal to gas or electricity, for example by paying part of the cost of connecting private homes to the gas network. Second, public transport must become a genuine alternative to the car: fast bus lanes, affordable fares and a modern metro would persuade many drivers to leave their cars at home. Finally, stricter emission standards and regular vehicle inspections would gradually remove the most polluting cars from the roads.

In conclusion, urban air pollution results from traffic, coal-based energy and, in some places, unfavourable geography. Although no single measure will solve it, cleaner heating combined with attractive public transport can make city air noticeably healthier within a decade.

note.en: The topic sentence of the causes paragraph.
Adds a second cause acting in parallel.
note.kk: Қатар әсер ететін екінші себепті қосады.

note.en: Specifies when the problem is worst.
note.kk: Мәселенің қашан ең өткір болатынын нақтылайды.

note.en: A logical bridge: many causes mean several measures.
note.kk: Логикалық көпір: себеп көп болса, шара да бірнешеу болуы керек.
note.ru: Логический мост: причин много — значит, и мер нужно несколько.

note.en: Shows what the solution looks like in practice.
note.kk: Шешімнің іс жүзінде қалай көрінетінін көрсетеді.
note.ru: Показывает, как решение выглядит на практике.

strengths.en: The task mentions cars and heating; the writer covers both and adds a third cause.
strengths.kk: Тапсырмада көліктер мен жылыту аталған — автор екеуін де талдап, үшінші себепті қосады.
strengths.ru: В задании названы машины и отопление — автор разбирает обе версии и добавляет третью.
strengths.example: At the same time, power stations and private houses that burn coal

strengths.en: Each measure answers a stated cause directly, so Task Response is complete.
strengths.kk: Әр шара аталған себепке тікелей жауап береді — Task Response толық.
strengths.ru: Каждая мера прямо отвечает на названную причину — Task Response полный.
strengths.example: help power plants and households switch from coal to gas or electricity

strengths.en: First / Second / Finally guide the reader through the solutions — Coherence and Cohesion at 8.
strengths.kk: First / Second / Finally оқырманды шешімдер бойымен жүргізеді — бұл Coherence and Cohesion 8.
strengths.ru: First / Second / Finally ведут читателя по решениям — это Coherence and Cohesion 8.
strengths.example: Second, public transport must become a genuine alternative to the car

strengths.en: Topic vocabulary without repetition: haze, emission standards, trapped close to the ground.
strengths.kk: Тақырыпқа сай терминдер қайталаусыз: haze, emission standards, trapped close to the ground.
strengths.ru: Термины по теме без повторов: haze, emission standards, trapped close to the ground.
strengths.example: polluted air is trapped close to the ground

note.en: Introduction: a familiar image (smog over Almaty) and a thesis — several causes, so a combined solution.
note.kk: Кіріспе: таныс көрініс (Алматы үстіндегі түтін) және тезис — себеп бірнешеу, шешім кешенді.
note.ru: Введение: узнаваемая картина (смог над Алматы) и тезис — причин несколько, решение комплексное.

note.en: Causes: cars, coal and geography. Both suggestions in the task are covered, plus a third cause.
note.kk: Себептер: көліктер, көмір және география. Тапсырмадағы екі нұсқа да талданған, үстіне үшінші себеп қосылған.
note.ru: Причины: машины, уголь и география. Обе версии из задания разобраны, плюс третья причина.

note.en: Solutions in order — First / Second / Finally — each matched to a cause and explained.
note.kk: Шешімдер First / Second / Finally ретімен — әрқайсысы өз себебіне жауап беріп, қалай жұмыс істейтінін түсіндіреді.
note.ru: Решения по порядку First / Second / Finally — каждое отвечает на свою причину и объясняет, как сработает.

note.en: The conclusion briefly repeats the causes and main solution, realistically — “no single measure”.
note.kk: Қорытынды себептер мен басты шешімді қысқа қайталайды, шынайы түрде — «no single measure».
note.ru: Вывод кратко повторяет причины и главное решение, реалистично — «no single measure».

document.title: Air pollution in cities
document.question:
Air pollution has become a serious problem in many large cities. Some people blame the growing number of cars, while others point to industry and the way homes are heated.

What are the main causes of this problem, and what solutions can you suggest?

Give reasons for your answer and include any relevant examples from your own knowledge or experience.
